title: Китай и «промышленный солнечный пояс» обгоняют Европу в гонке чистой индустрии

title: Talarico flips Texas Senate seat in historic win for Democrats
snippet: The former teacher and Presbyterian seminarian, 37, is the first Democrat to win statewide office in Texas since 1994.

title: Democrat Troy Jackson unseats longtime Republican Senator Susan Collins in Maine
snippet: Jackson, 58, who became the party's nominee only in July, will succeed Collins, who was seeking her sixth term representing the state in the Senate.
